<!-- release notes for v0.4.1 -->
## What's Changed

### Added
- Detection corpus metric floors are documented, and clustering regression coverage now asserts input-order invariance and threshold-boundary behavior (#282).

### Changed
- `export-lesson` now uses the shared human-review gate and blocks candidates with unanswered review questions unless `--allow-incomplete-review` is passed (#163).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dgenio/lessonweaver/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1
